# MCP tools contract (v1)

<!-- Generated by `go test ./internal/mcpserver -update` from the tool list. Do not edit by hand. -->

`stkr mcp` is a Model Context Protocol server over stdio. Server name `stkr`; the version is the STKR version. It offers the tools below, the resource `stkr://manifest` (markdown) and the prompts `start_day` and `close_day`.

## Conventions

- Every tool returns a one-line text summary plus structured JSON (`structuredContent`) that matches the output fields below. Durations are integer seconds in `*_seconds` fields; times are RFC 3339 with the configured zone offset.
- Errors are MCP tool errors (`isError: true`) whose text starts with a code: `[invalid]`, `[not_found]`, `[conflict]`, `[unavailable]` or `[internal]` (details are in the STKR log). A request that breaks the input schema is rejected as a protocol error before the tool runs.
- Limits: text fields up to 10 KB (short fields 500 bytes), `limit` 1 to 200 (default 50). Time events are recorded with source `mcp`.
- Privacy: personal ideas, items of personal and system projects and the notes of personal and system time are never returned. No tool returns configuration, paths or secrets.
- Changes within v1 are additive: new optional inputs and new output fields.

## Tools

### `add_idea`

Capture an idea. With type action or decision it becomes a follow-up item of the current project instead. Capture is instant; AI cleanup runs later.

Access: changes data.

Input:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tag` | string | no | pro (default) or personal; personal ideas are never shown back to agents |
| `text` | string | yes | the idea, action or decision text (max 10 KB) |
| `type` | string | no | note (default, an idea), action or decision (a follow-up item for the current project) |

Output (top-level fields):

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `created` | boolean |
| `idea` | object |
| `item` | object |

### `get_day`

Return the time report of one day: events, blocks, gaps and totals per context. Notes of personal and system contexts are removed.

Access: read only.

Input:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `date` | string | no | YYYY-MM-DD, today or yesterday; default today |

Output (top-level fields):

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `blocks` | array |
| `counted_seconds` | integer |
| `date` | string |
| `events` | array |
| `gap_seconds` | integer |
| `gaps` | array |
| `idle_suspect_seconds` | integer |
| `totals` | array |
| `weekday` | string |
| `window_end` | string |
| `window_start` | string |
| `working_day` | boolean |

### `get_digest`

Return the Start Day or Close Day prompt text, including the fence format the reply must use. Does not copy to the clipboard, switch context or write files.

Access: read only.

Input:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string | yes | start (morning brief prompt) or close (end-of-day prompt) |

Output (top-level fields):

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `chars` | integer |
| `kind` | string |
| `text` | string |

### `get_now`

Return the context being tracked, since when, and the counted time today.

Access: read only.

Input:

None.

Output (top-level fields):

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `context` | object |
| `elapsed_seconds` | integer |
| `event_id` | integer |
| `idle_suspect` | boolean |
| `note` | string |
| `since` | string |
| `today_counted_seconds` | integer |
| `tracking` | boolean |

### `get_week`

Return the time report of one ISO week: seven day reports and totals per context. Totals are unrounded.

Access: read only.

Input:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `week` | string | no | ISO week such as 2026-W47; default the current week |

Output (top-level fields):

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `counted_seconds` | integer |
| `days` | array |
| `end` | string |
| `gap_seconds` | integer |
| `idle_suspect_seconds` | integer |
| `start` | string |
| `totals` | array |
| `week` | string |
| `working_days` | integer |

### `list_contexts`

List the contexts (projects, modes, personal, system) you can switch to.

Access: read only.

Input:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `include_inactive` | boolean | no | also return parked (inactive) contexts |

Output (top-level fields):

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `contexts` | array |
| `count` | integer |

### `list_ideas`

List captured ideas, newest first. Personal ideas are never returned.

Access: read only.

Input:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | maximum ideas to return, newest first (default 50, max 200) |
| `status` | string | no | new, triaged, done or archived; default any |
| `tag` | string | no | pro or personal; personal ideas are never returned |

Output (top-level fields):

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `count` | integer |
| `ideas` | array |

### `list_items`

List follow-up items (action, decision, note, followup, risk), newest first. Items of personal and system projects are never returned.

Access: read only.

Input:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | maximum items to return, newest first (default 50, max 200) |
| `project` | string | no | project context id |
| `since` | string | no | only items captured on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD, today, yesterday) |
| `status` | string | no | open or done; default any |

Output (top-level fields):

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `count` | integer |
| `items` | array |

### `report_agent_event`

Report the state of a coding agent window (idle, working, action_required, done, error) so STKR can show it and map its workspace to a context.

Access: changes data.

Input:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `event` | string | no | state (default), focused or closed |
| `instance` | string | yes | stable id of the agent window or session |
| `slot` | integer | no | Stream Deck slot number, if any |
| `state` | string | no | idle, working, action_required, done or error |
| `summary` | string | no | what the agent is doing (cut to 200 characters) |
| `window_title` | string | no | title of the agent window |
| `workspace` | string | no | workspace folder; mapped to a context when it matches a context workdir |

Output (top-level fields):

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `closed` | boolean |
| `context_id` | string |
| `context_label` | string |
| `instance` | string |
| `mapped` | boolean |
| `state` | string |
| `switched` | boolean |

### `stop`

Stop tracking time (switches to the off context).

Access: changes data.

Input:

None.

Output (top-level fields):

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `created` | boolean |
| `event` | object |

### `switch_context`

Start tracking time on a context (project or mode). Ends the current block. Switching to the context already active is a no-op.

Access: changes data.

Input:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `context` | string | yes | context id to start tracking, for example a project id; see list_contexts |
| `note` | string | no | optional short note for the time block |

Output (top-level fields):

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `created` | boolean |
| `event` | object |

### `triage_idea`

Change the status, project, tag or title of an idea. Only the fields you pass change.

Access: changes data.

Input:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | yes | idea id from list_ideas |
| `project` | string | no | project context id to file the idea under; empty clears it |
| `status` | string | no | new, triaged, done or archived |
| `tag` | string | no | pro or personal |
| `title` | string | no | short title |

Output (top-level fields):

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `context_id` | string |
| `id` | integer |
| `source` | string |
| `status` | string |
| `suggested_project` | string |
| `tag` | string |
| `text` | string |
| `title` | string |
| `ts` | string |

## Example

Request:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"switch_context","arguments":{"context":"planning","note":"morning plan"}}}
```

Result (shortened):

```json
{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Now tracking planning"}],"structuredContent":{"event":{"id":7,"context_id":"planning","source":"mcp"},"created":true}}
```

Error result:

```json
{"isError":true,"content":[{"type":"text","text":"[not_found] context \"nope\" not found"}]}
```
